name: Critical Path Method
excerpt: The Critical Path Method determines the shortest time to complete a project.
notes: The Critical Path Method involves identifying critical activities with zero slack, which cannot be delayed without affecting the project timeline. It uses a two-pass process (forward and backward) to determine the shortest project duration.
context_summary: - Determines the shortest time to complete a project.
- Identifies critical activities with zero slack.
- Uses a two-pass process: forward and backward.
- Critical activities cannot be delayed without affecting the timeline.
